package app

import (
	"example.com/atk/billing"
	"example.com/atk/orders"
	"example.com/atk/router"
	"example.com/atk/users"
)

func Routes() *router.Router {
	mux := router.New()
	users.Mount(mux, users.Config{Prefix: orders.Config{}.Prefix})
	users.Mount(mux, users.Config{})
	orders.Mount(mux, orders.Config{})
	billing.Mount(mux, billing.Config{})

	return mux
}
